reproduction.expected: A host-independent CLI can initialize, validate, explain and compile versioned Project, Skill Contract and Workflow declarations into the existing canonical runtime contract.
reproduction.actual: skillctl rejects the authoring command and the repository has no common declaration loader, semantic compiler or no-LLM authoring interface.

violated_invariants: ChatGPT and Codex are replaceable Host adapters, not the sole owner of Harness declarations.
Declarative authoring must compile into the existing WorkflowSpec and runtime rather than create a second execution authority.
Open declarations must be strict, versioned, explainable and maintainable without a model.
